videos.why: The only Short rank lists as ready. Frame 0 shows a LAS VEGAS sign over a giant slot machine with $16,772 on its jackpot screen, and the first line states it per minute. It zooms out per hour, day and year on sourced Nevada Gaming Control Board figures and turns on 'after paying every winner'. Scored a little above rank's 6.5 for the first frame and the payoff, which loops back to the hook.
strengths: Name and figure in the first second, readable on mute
Money at a scale people can feel (per minute, per hour, per day)
Seven directed places, every figure on a thing (jackpot screen, chip tower, truck, billboard, bucket)
risks: A casino topic ran on the channel before ('Why the casino always wins')
Las Vegas is a place, not a famous person
